programs.title: Building Alaska

programs.title: House Hunters International
programs.sub_title: From London to Amsterdam, I'm Being Followed by a Housing Crisis
programs.desc: A couple is forced out of their apartment by skyrocketing rents after the pandemic in London. They've made the decision to move to Amsterdam after he was able to secure a job transfer, only to find that the housing crisis has followed them.

programs.title: House Hunters International
programs.desc: A couple puts horses before humans in their search for the perfect home in Matarrana, Spain. They're looking for something remote with plenty of land for her horse training business, but finding the right place in their budget will be a challenge.

programs.title: House Hunters International
programs.sub_title: Thirty Before Thirty in So Cal
programs.desc: A Los Angeles buyer's goal of getting her first home is the highlight of her plan to do thirty things before turning 30-years-old. But in this pricey market, having to choose between the size, location and character she wants isn't easy.
